description.value: 49th Parallel Coffee Roasters is a celebrated BC-based specialty coffee chain; the Lonsdale location is their fifth cafe, opened March 2022. It occupies a heritage building whose interior design draws from the site's early-1900s mercantile history as a hardware store, using repurposed materials to create an authentic, permanent feel. For a touring cyclist rolling through North Vancouver, it offers a well-regarded espresso program and takeout in a distinctive stop on Lonsdale Avenue.
